description: A forum post or reply. Lives in the author's user repo; references its thread via strongRef.

community.description: DID of the community (denormalized for scoping).

root.description: The forum.thread this post belongs to.

parent.description: The post being replied to; absent for top-level posts.

embeds.description: Optional media attachments stored as blobs (see blob config).

author.description: The member who wrote this record. Present when the record is stored in the community's repository (a private community) and not in the author's own.

authorSig.description: The author's signature over this record without `authorSig`. Present together with `author`.

key.description: did:key of the author's atproto signing key.

sig.description: base64url signature over the CID of the record without `authorSig`.
